text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Man, it's really summer, ain't it?
choice_data_list: It's summer, huh~

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Sure is hot, huh~
choice_data_list: 夏だねぇ
choice_data_list_en: Summer's really here, huh.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Ahhh...
choice_data_list: 夏だからねぇ
choice_data_list_en: Well, it is summer.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Oh, good grief. To think that Sei-chan of 
all people would have her mind read so 
easily.
choice_data_list: もしかして、暇なの？
choice_data_list_en: Are you free right now?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Far from reading your mind, it was written 
all over you... In short, you were telling 
me how bored you were, right?
choice_data_list: Wanna go fishing?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Summer means the beach, and the beach 
means fishing. Is that kinda... the 
impression you have of Sei-chan?
choice_data_list: 釣りでも行く？
choice_data_list_en: Want to go fishing or something?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... I'm just not really feelin' it 
though.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—From what I hear, everywhere's been 
crowded lately.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
There are some hidden gems, but lately 
even those places have seen more tourists 
and gotten pretty lively, or so I've 
heard.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Well, spending time in the usual place and 
having our usual lively fun isn't bad at 
all, though~.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
"As for Sei-chan, occasionally getting 
away from the hustle and bustle and 
enjoying a summer different from the usual 
sounds pretty nice, y'know?"
choice_data_list:
A summer that's different from usual, 
huh...

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Doesn't that kind of thing feel... kinda 
special?
choice_data_list: 普段とは違う夏かぁ
choice_data_list_en: A summer unlike any other, huh?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
"I thought it'd be nice every once in a 
while~ but is it too difficult, nya~?"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"A special feeling... a summer unlike any 
other. Indeed, under those conditions, 
it'd be tough without a really exceptional 
place."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
However, it wouldn't hurt to keep looking 
without giving up. After searching through 
various options, we decided to head out 
together.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Ooooh, there's really nobody here at all. 
And it's so quiet... well, maybe not 
quite.
choice_data_list:
I can hear insects I've never heard 
before...

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Ah, you're right... There are multiple 
voices, and it's hard to make out each 
one, but... there's some strange voices 
too...
choice_data_list: 聞いたことのない虫の声が……
choice_data_list_en: That's an insect chirp I've never heard before...

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
...... ...Ahh... Listening to the bugs is 
making me sleepy.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Oh. There's shade under the trees over 
there, so maybe we can take a nap.
choice_data_list:
That looks nice and cool... Just a 
little...

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Just a little, pretty please~
choice_data_list: 涼しそうだね……少しだけ……
choice_data_list_en: It looks cool... just for a little while...

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Man, that was a good sleep. I'm sweating a 
bit, but hey, it is summer after all.
choice_data_list: Shall we go cool off for a bit?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Indeed~.
choice_data_list: ちょっと、涼みに行こうか
choice_data_list_en: Let's go cool off for a bit.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Ah, a refreshing breeze and the scent of 
pasture grass... Summer's really here.
choice_data_list: They had soft serve!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, nice find. Just water wasn't really 
cutting it for me~.
choice_data_list: ソフトクリームがあったよ
choice_data_list_en: They've got soft serve!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
"Trainer, what'll you have? Sei-chan might 
go with watermelon milk~ It looks like a 
summer exclusive."
choice_data_list: I wonder if that's summer mandarin milk?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
That sounds good too~ Let's trade and have 
a taste.
choice_data_list: 夏ミカンミルクかな
choice_data_list_en: Summer orange milk, maybe?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Excuse me, could we get one of each of the 
summer flavor soft-serves, please~?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Ah, it's so humid. ...Wait, where even are 
we??
choice_data_list: I wonder where...

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Eeeh~... Wasn't this the place you chose, 
Trainer?
choice_data_list: どこだろう……
choice_data_list_en: Where could it be...?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, you're just as guilty, Sei-chan! I 
was having such a nice dream, too.
choice_data_list: 電車の中で居眠りしてたら……ここに……
choice_data_list_en: I was dozing off on the train, and then... ended up here...

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Still, there's really nothing here at all~ 
I guess we're done here. Time to head 
back... huh?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
There was a cat over there just now! A 
huge one, like nothing I've ever seen 
before!
choice_data_list: Like a wildcat? Isn't that dangerous?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Alright, Trainer-san. Go on ahead.
choice_data_list: ヤマネコ的な？危なくない？
choice_data_list_en: Like a wildcat? Isn't that dangerous?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—In the end, we never found the big cat. 
Drenched in sweat from the humidity, where 
we finally ended up was—
choice_data_list: えー！？
choice_data_list_en: Ehhh?!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Summer really is all about the beach, huh.
choice_data_list: Yeah, I guess so...

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
"What were we wandering around for today 
again...?"
choice_data_list: そうだねぇ……
choice_data_list_en: Yeah, I guess so...

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
"Oh right, that's how it was. ...Wait, 
what I ended up doing wasn't any different 
from usual!"
choice_data_list: なんか……特別な夏、みたいな……
choice_data_list_en: Like... a special summer, or something...

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Well, I just threw out a comeback on 
impulse, but...
choice_data_list: 特別な夏ではなかったね……
choice_data_list_en: It wasn't that special of a summer, was it...

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
"This is fine in its own way, wouldn't you 
say?"

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
We went to places we don't usually go, so 
in a way, that felt kind of "special" too, 
y'know?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
"Besides, you looked like you were having 
plenty of fun yourself, Trainer, meow~."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...True enough. I carried on without 
really understanding what a 'special 
summer' was supposed to be... but it 
certainly wasn't boring."
choice_data_list: That was definitely good exercise!

Still, I'd love to search for a "special 
summer" again someday.
Maybe that was a good experience?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Man, Sei-chan's gonna get even stronger 
again~.
choice_data_list: いい運動にはなった！
でもいつかまた『特別な夏』も探したいな
いい経験ができたかも？
choice_data_list_en: Well, at least it was good exercise!
But someday I'd like to find another 'Special Summer,' too.
Maybe that was a good experience?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: ――Ah. Trainer, look at that.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Oh. Still full of motivation, aren't we? 
Though that might have to wait until next 
year, meow~.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: ――Ah. Trainer, look at that.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
No doubt about it. Even if it wasn't 
particularly extraordinary, it was still a 
summer a little different from the usual.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: ――Ah. Trainer, look at that.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The sound of fireworks echoes in the 
distance. Listening closely, lively voices 
of the crowd can also be heard. Looking 
carefully, fireworks were rising far, far 
away.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: ...Not quite a clamor, nor is it quiet.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: My, oh my, what a pleasantly mild summer.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Though we didn't find a "special summer," 
we discovered a "just-right summer" that 
felt just a little bit different from the 
usual.
